name: issue_1433_away_grace_tou_bank_holds_home
description: Issue #1433 (time-of-use mirror, #1409/#1410): home inside a pre-heat bank window (heat 76 F), you step out for 10 minutes; a 30-minute cycle inside the 15-minute away timer must not write the Away bank or band; back home the home bank is kept and the band after the period is the home band.
source: synthetic: Issue #1433 mirror review (TOU bank), built on tou_away_heat_bank_home_return_1404
notes: Occupant outcome: during a pre-heat before a high-cost period you step out briefly. The Away bank (or the Away band) must wait for the 15-minute timer like the plain setback, so the pre-heat to 76 F is not cut short by a short errand; the period then coasts and the home band 68 F returns at 16:15.

Drives the real occupancy toggle and its real away timer (home_toggle_entity) and the cycle's apply_classification() + _apply_tou_schedule() (classification event), the same order production runs them.
(a) Scenario effectiveness: on 0.9.7 the 15:55 cycle inside the away timer writes the Away pre-heat bank, so the empty-writes assertion fails (see the issue's test report).
(b) Docs <-> production: docs/scheduler-spec.md and docs/occupancy-dispatch-spec.md: the Away/Vacation bank is the away setback's time-of-use form; the setback fires on the timer's expiry.
(c) User outcome if this regresses: a short errand during a pre-heat drops the heat target to the Away bank and the house enters the high-cost period colder.
